selection_rationale: Declared atlas experimental schedule context. v33 introduces kitchen-equipment tables required by pinned sampler group 6; all declared group source members checked. No national.yml archive/version claim. Public integration CSV supplies explicit 2018 stock context, which does not enter selected table closure.

standalone_policy.comparison_boundary: Same ordered conditional row and identical supplied uniform draw must select same discrete option; source transformation compared at identical selected parameters; wrapper determinism is separate; population matrices/Sobol excluded
standalone_policy.coupling: One ordered draw per parameter per coordinated operating group, including degenerate distributions
standalone_policy.name: atlas_conditional_seeded_v1
standalone_policy.raw_cdf_tail: No renormalization or fabricated final option; a supplied draw outside a subunit raw CDF has no upstream selectable option and must error.
standalone_policy.seed_derivation: SHA-256 canonical(["atlas_conditional_seeded_v1", master_seed, operating_group]); full digest interpreted as unsigned big-endian integer

standards_dependency.interpretation_note: Actual declared runtime transform dependency; separate from atlas frozen Standards develop definitions

upstream_population_context.external_rng_initialization: No seed argument or global initialization in pinned sampler; no external initialization established from inspected README/configurations
upstream_population_context.pseudorandom_flat_position: b*d*m + k*m + j within group, plus preceding groups; m=sample_count/bucket_count
required_for_replay: Sobol library version, Python random shift state and pandas shuffle RNG state if Sobol
upstream_population_context.sampler_mode: CLI Sobol default; --random selects NumPy global pseudorandom matrices
